ammonia.reason: No proteolysis/deamination in fresh unripened whey curd; ammonia not detected.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole not detected; fresh whey with no fecal Enterobacteriaceae metabolism.

bitter.reason: No chymosin/plasmin hydrophobic bitter peptides; fresh acid-heat precipitation with days age.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; 2-heptanone ~34 ug/kg and 2-nonanone ~14 ug/kg are heat background not mold lipolysis.

browning.reason: White high-moisture low free amino-acid curd; minimal Maillard until dried/heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin nd with no LAB citrate fermentation; only ~10% milk fat for lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic acid only ~3.35 ug/kg equiv fresh; minimal lipolysis in fresh acid-heat curd.

creaminess.reason: High moisture ~74.7% plus 10% fat as fine denatured lactalbumin particles gives creamy spoonable mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Moist granular whey-protein gel deforms rather than fractures; no pressed demineralized matrix.

firmness.reason: Very high moisture denatured whey-protein gel with no rennet network; soft not firm.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not found; no phenylalanine catabolism without ripening.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate ~1.82 ug/kg and ethyl hexanoate ~2.14 ug/kg only; no esterase flora or ethanol fermentation.

goaty.reason: 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids not found; C6-C8 acids at ug/kg levels only, no goat-milk branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-methylpropanal ~46.5 ug/kg from Strecker degradation during ~90C whey heating gives faint malty note.

melt.reason: Heat-denatured whey proteins already coagulated cannot flow; softens/dries on heating as non-melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol ~14 ug/kg from linoleate lipoxygenase at sub-threshold; no mold 1-octen-3-one pathway.

oil_off.reason: Only ~10% fat entrapped in whey-protein gel; no free oil release on heating.

smoky.reason: Typical plain fresca with no smoke exposure; smoked variants excluded from typical.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid ~26.8 ug/kg trace only and pH ~6.06; no lactic-acid accumulation from starter.

stretch.reason: No intact paracasein network at pH 5.2 demineralization; acid-heat curd cannot form fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Beta-lactoglobulin denaturation at 85-90C releases H2S/thiols; dimethyl sulfide ~3.94 ug/kg cooked-milky note.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/whey solids at pH 6.06 with no acid conversion gives sweet milky taste.

umami.reason: Minimal free glutamate/peptides with no rennet proteolysis or long aging for savory depth.
